scripts.build: bun run --filter @openparley/overlay build && bun run --filter @openparley/site build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p . && tsc -p packages/brand && tsc -p packages/overlay && tsc -p apps/sync && tsc -p apps/site && tsc -p ee/cloud && tsc -p e2e
scripts.test: bun scripts/check-boundaries.ts && bun run --filter @openparley/overlay test && bun run --filter @openparley/sync test && bun run --filter @openparley/cloud test && bun run --filter @openparley/site test
scripts.e2e: bun run --filter @openparley/overlay build && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts
